import copy
out=copy.deepcopy(grid)
marker=(0,8)
# identify the marker's inward cut line, column 8
line=[(r,8) for r in range(20)]
far=max(r for r,c in line if grid[r][c]==7)
# remove all off-line 7s from original positions
left=[(r,c) for r in range(20) for c in range(8) if grid[r][c]==7]
right=[(r,c) for r in range(20) for c in range(9,20) if grid[r][c]==7]
for r,c in left+right: out[r][c]=1
# cut line recolored from marker through last 7, preserving 7

    if out[r][8] != 7: out[r][8]=2
# align each side's set to its corresponding top corner
for cells, side in ((left,'left'),(right,'right')):
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
    minc=min(c for r,c in cells); maxc=max(c for r,c in cells)
    dr=-minr
    dc= -minc if side=='left' else 19-maxc
    moved=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in cells]
    print(side, (minr,maxr,minc,maxc), (dr,dc), (min(r for r,c in moved),max(r for r,c in moved),min(c for r,c in moved),max(c for r,c in moved)), 'collisions', [(r,c) for r,c in moved if out[r][c]!=1])
    for r,c in moved: out[r][c]=7
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('rows as lists =',out)
